methodology: Closed loop, no think time, one worker per concurrent request. Latency begins at dispatch (no artificial client queue). TTFT is arrival of first generated token ID in the HTTP stream, including tokens without visible text. First visible text is recorded separately and can be null. Streamed token counts must match final usage and the fixed output budget. Warmup excluded. Throughput counts successful completion tokens / full run wall time, including failed requests. A failed request invalidates the experiment; there are no retries.
